reviews.title: Great design and build quality, also big and heavy
reviews.comment:
This was bigger than I thought, but that's my fault for skimming over the specs. My old mini/mid tower case could fit inside this thing. It's also heavy!

Regardless of the physical aspects, it's a great case. Every panel is easy to remove, and there's plenty of space. The brown is a little lighter in person than it looks online, but it's still nice.

It's a little unclear from the images, but the top panel pops off to expose the mobo's I/O shield, and cables can route through a couple of holes in the back. I have a wifi antenna and HDMI cable running out of mine and there's enough room between the plugs and the top panel so that the cables aren't squished down or anything. Like I said, plenty of room.

This was delivered from the manufacturer in the original box that includes product images on the sides, and could easily be mistaken for a computer by any porch pirates, so keep that in mind. The packaging inside was fine and my unit had no damage issues.
reviews.author: TWKY
